artifacts.summary: Validation REJECTED as registered (re-scored independently, all 30 runs, matches). Startup words: index 628 of 5499 (11%), bar 25%, pass. Rules followed in total: 13 of 15 each arm, pass. Per probe: P1 index 1 of 3 vs whole 3 of 3, worse by two, bar allows one, fail. The index arm's two P1 misses were not the bare-name rule (both followed it) but dropping a checklist item the situation gave verbatim after opening the number-guards file, a behaviour the whole-README arm never showed. Three of five probes were followed in every run by both arms, so the POC cannot show the index is better. Tokens: the index arm used slightly more (27.6k vs 26.2k mean). Upstream finding: Spacedock's FO boot opens no README body; reading the whole README is kc-dev-flow-2's own convention, so an index would change only the package. Not shown: long sessions, where the observer's violations come from; a live FO.
